description: Main application component for the BugFlow frontend, managing theme, navigation, and rendering different views such as authentication, demo, and dashboard.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: React functional component managing overall app state, theme, and view rendering.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: showDemo
methods.description: Sets the current view to the theme demo.

methods.name: handleAuthSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful authentication, setting user data and navigating to dashboard.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user and returns to the welcome screen.

methods.name: renderContent
methods.description: Renders different components based on currentView state.
